senses.gloss: (I)--a son of ऋत, and father of वीतहव्य. भा. IX. १३. २६.
(II)--a son of गृतसमद, and father of शौ- naka. भा. IX. १७. 3; Br. III. ६७. 4; वा. ९२. 4.
(III)--the minister of Puramjaya; killed his king and placed his own son Pradyota on the throne. भा. XII. 1. 3; Br. III. ७४. १२३.
(IV)--a disciple of Pathya. भा. XII. 7. 2.
(V)--approached by केशिध्वज to give him a form of expiation. Vi. VI. 6. १६. [page३-450+ २७]

(I)--the second son of Ajigarta (Satyavati and ऋचीक) purchased by Rohita and used by हरिश्चन्द्र as a sacrificial animal in the place of his son. Adopted as son by विश्वामित्र. When his first fifty sons refused to recognise him as their brother, they were cursed to be Mlecchas. The younger fifty agreed to regard him as their brother and were blessed. He is शुन to भृगु family and देवरात to the गाधि line. His advent with the कौशिक family distin- guished it from the विश्वामित्रस्; compared to प्रह्लाद. भा. IX. 7. २१; १६. ३०-37; VII. 5. ४६; Br. III. ६६. ६६ and ७४; वा. ९१. ९२-6.
(II)--the second son of Jamadagni. Br. III. ६६. ६४.
--the last son of Jamadagni (सत्यवती and ऋचीक). Br. III. ६६. ६४; वा. ९१. ९२.
--the daughter of Samudra and wife of वरुण; two sons Kali and Vaidhya and a daughter, Sura- सुन्दरी. वा. ८४. 6.
--a kingdom of the west watered by the Sindhu. Br. II. १८. ४९; M. १२१. ४७; वा. ४७. ४६.
--a काद्रवेय na1ga. Br. III. 7. ३५.
--a R. from the ऋष्यवान्. M. ११४. २६.

--the city of भण्ड on the banks of the महार्णव (sea?) near Mahendra hill: In extent १०० Yojanas: filled with चन्द्रशालस्, pleasure parks, सभा, tem- ples and so on: protected by कुटिलाक्ष on all sides when it was attacked by fifty अक्षौहिनिस् of soldiers;
1: Br. IV. २१. 3-२०, ९६; २२. २२; २३. ९८; २६. २१.
burnt by ललिता with civil population.
2: Ib. IV. २९. २१. १४३.
--the Lord of the city of शून्यक. Br. IV. २२. १०८.
--a son of Kubera. भा. IX. 2. ३३.
(I)--a son of Manudeva and father of पुष्- kara (Kinnara-वि। प्।). भा. IX. १२. १२; M. २७१. 8; Vi. IV. २२. 4.
(II)--a son of निरामित्र and father of बृहत्सेन. भा. IX. २२. ४७.
(III)--a son of Sahadeva. वा. ९९. २८४.

(I)--a chief attendant on विष्णु;
1: भा. I. १४. ३२; II. 9. १४; VII. 8. ३९; VIII. २०. ३२; २२. १५; X. ३९. ५३; ८९. ५७.
a celibate and devoted to Hari. Praised Dhruva and followed Hari go- ing to पृथु's sacrifice.
2: Ib. IV. 9. ३०; १२. २२; १९. 5.
Attacked Asura followers of Bali.
3: VIII. २१. १६.
(II)--a disciple of ब्रह्मा. वा. २२. १६.
(I)--R., on its bank Manu (स्वायम्भुव) practised तपस् renouncing the world. भा. VIII. 1. 8.
(II)--a daughter of सारणा. Br. III. ७१. १६८; वा. ९६. १६६.
(III)--a mind-born mother. M. १७९. १२.
--a gopa friend of Nanda. भा. X. ३४. 4.
(I)--a son of कृष्ण. भा. X. ९०. ३४.
(II)--a son of पुरीषभीरु and father of Cakora. भा. XII. 1. २५-26.
(I)--a Janapada of the भद्रा country. वा. ४३. १९. [page३-632+ २४]
(II)--a forest in the ब्रह्मक्षेत्रम्. वा. ५९. १२९.
--a son of Nandana. Vi. IV. २४. ५६.
(I)--a son of Pariplava (Paripluta-वा। प्।, पारि- plava-वि। प्।) and father of मेधावि. भा. IX. २२. ४३; वा. ९९. २७५; वा. IV. २१. १२.
(II)--an Ajita deva. Br. II. १३. ९३.
(III)--a son of Kratu (ऋतु-वा। प्।) and father of वीतहव्य. Br. III. ६४. २२; वा. ८७. २२; Vi. IV. 5. ३१.
--a son of विश्वामित्र, conferred by Devas; was the well-known देवसूत. Vi. IV. 7. ३७.
--a son of Jambu and कावेरी. Br. III. ६६. ३०. [page३-633+ २६]
--a son of क्षत्रवृद्ध. Father of कश and two other righteous sons. Br. III. ६७. 3.
(I)--a son of अजात and an Andhaka. M. ४४. ८४.
(II)--a son of गरुड in श्वेतोदर hill. वा. ३९. ५६.
(II)--a pupil of लौगाक्षी. Br. II. ३५. ४१.
(III)--a son of देवकी and Vasudeva. Br. III. ७१. १८३.
(IV)--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्य- कशिपु. M. १६१. ७९.
--a name for देवकी, a daughter of Devaka. वा. ९६. १३१.
--one of Vasudeva's wives. Br. III. ७१. १६१.
--the city of कालकेयस्; on the देवकूट in मर्याद parvata. वा. ४०. ११-15. [page३-634+ २८]
(II)--a son of Sutala and father of Satyajit. Vi. IV. २३. 9-१०.
(I)--a son of Santati and father of Suketana (Suketu-वा। प्। & वि। प्।); a righteous king. भा. IX. १७. 8; वा. ९२. ६९; Vi. IV. 8. १९.
(II)--a son of सुषेण and father of नृचक्षु (नृपचक्षु-वि। प्।). भा. IX. २२. ४१; M. ५०. ८१; Vi. IV. २१. १२.
(III)--a son of Subala and father of Satyajit. भा. IX. २२. ४९.
(IV)--a son of Saunati and father of क्षेम. Br. III. ६७. ७३.
(V)--a son of सत्या and कृष्ण. Br. III. ७१. २५२.
(VI)--a son of नाग्नजिति(jit) and कृष्ण. M. ४७. १९; वा. ९६. २४३.
(VII)--a son of श्रुतश्रवस् and Caidya; a righteous monarch. M. ४६. 6. [page३-635+ २५]
(VIII)--a son of क्षेम. M. ४९. ७९.
(IX)--in the गयाशिला. वा. १०८. ४८.

--daughter of मृत्य(u) (पितृस्); queen of Anga and mother of Vena; informed beforehand of Vena's coronation; protected his dead body of मन्त्रस्। भा. IV. १३. १८; १४. 2 & ३५; Br. II. ३६. १०८. M. 4. ४४; १०. 3; वा. ६२. ९३, १०८. Vi. I. १३. 7, ११.
(I)--a son of शुकी and गरुड. Br. III. 7. ४५०.
(II)--a बृहद्रथ; ruled for ४० years. Br. III. ७४. १२९; वा. ९९. ३०६.
(IV)--a son of Anuvrata, ruled for २५ years. M. २७१. २६.
(V)--a यक्ष king in कैलास. वा. ४१. २५.
(VI)--a son of मणिवर. वा. ६९. १६०.
(VII)--a son of Niramitra and father of बृहद्- karma. Vi. IV. २३. 4. [page३-636+ २६]
(III)--a son of कौशिक in previous births, born as चक्रवाक in मानस. M. २०. १८.
--a सुधर्मान god. Br. IV. 1. ६१.

--a son of ह्राद (Nisunda-वा। प्।) father of मारीच through ताडका;
1: Br. III. 5. ३४-5; वा. ६७. ७१, ७२.
an Asura.
2: Vi. V. 1. २४.
--a तीर्थ fit for श्राद्ध offering. Br. III. १३. ४७.
(I)--शान्तिकर्ण, ruled for a year. M. २७३. ११.
(II)--a son of Pulindasena and father of शत- कर्णि. Vi. IV. २४. ४७.
(I)--one of the four queens of भण्ड. Br. IV. १२. १३.

(II)--a name of ललिता; a mother goddess;
1: Br. IV. १८. १५; M. १७९. २९.
pre- siding deity of the Cakra-Guptatara.
2: Br. IV. ३६. ७८.
--a son of Sumantu. भा. XII. 6. ७५.
--the region of अधर्म and Kali. भा. I. १७. ३८.

--the five obstacles to the attainment of heaven by a house-holder: कण्डनि, पेषणी, चुल्ली, जलकुम्भी, प्रमार्जनी, sins (husking, grinding, fire place, water pots and cleaning). To get rid of these sins he performs the five यज्ञस्। M. ५२. १५-16.
(I)--a wife of Dharma, and mother of Satyasena and others. भा. VIII. 1. २५.
(II)--mother of स्वधामा. भा. VIII. १३. २९.

(III)--a daughter of Dharma and लक्ष्मी, married उत्तानपाद;
1: Br. II. ३६. ८७. M. 4. ३४-5.
mother of Dhruva.
2: वा. ६२. ७५-6.
[page३-683+ ३०]
